scope: Peer-reviewed method foundations with local engineering implementations; separate from published-success catalog

methods.title: Fixed quantum features with a regularized classical head
methods.foundation_scope: Quantum feature spaces; not an advantage theorem for this circuit
methods.hypothesis: The fixed local measurements expose predictive nonlinear interactions without optimizing a quantum loss
methods.prefer_when: Establishing a low-optimization-cost quantum feature baseline
diagnose: classical Fourier features on identical angular inputs
methods.extension: Change encoding scale, observable support or fixed circuit using validation; preserve all input coordinates

methods.title: Local measured features with a classical RBF kernel
methods.foundation_scope: Projected quantum kernels and task/access-specific results; this is a local-feature engineering adaptation
methods.hypothesis: Nonlinear classical processing of accessible quantum observables helps beyond a linear head
methods.prefer_when: Comparing head complexity on the same measured feature family
methods.extension: Validate locality, measured feature budget and bandwidth; do not equate projection with quantum advantage

methods.title: Fidelity kernel with SVC or kernel ridge
methods.foundation_scope: Quantum kernel estimation; this exact-simulator kernel does not demonstrate a hardware or computational advantage
methods.hypothesis: State-overlap similarity aligns with the target better than local measured-feature similarity
methods.prefer_when: Moderate row counts and explicit willingness to pay quadratic Gram costs
diagnose: RBF and exact classical simulation controls
methods.extension: Validate feature-map and regularization choices; account for new-input kernel queries on hardware

methods.title: Trainable re-uploading circuit with local measurements
methods.foundation_scope: Re-uploading expressivity; this architecture and optimizer are an engineering adaptation, not an exact published winning model
methods.hypothesis: Task-adapted circuit features improve on the fixed circuit sufficiently to justify gradient costs
methods.prefer_when: Fixed feature models fit poorly and a measured gradient/training budget is available
methods.extension: Validate weak encoding, depth and readout choices; QNG or warm starts require their own matched-cost ablations

implementation_status: Three native SDK constructions and local tests; see VALIDATION.md for executed training coverage

offline_feature_student.role: vendor-inspired engineering companion; not another peer-reviewed success case
